submissions.content: Punching wood is your first priority. Gather Plum wood or Pine wood to craft a workbench. From there, upgrade to wooden tools immediately.
Iron ore spawns frequently below Y-level -15. You will need a stone pickaxe minimum to mine it successfully without losing the drop.
Diamonds are found deep underground, usually near bedrock. Use strip mining techniques and carry torches, as mobs can spawn in the dark.
Apples drop from leaves, but farming wheat to make bread provides a more reliable food source. Keep your hunger bar full to regenerate health.
Moonstone is highly valuable. Crafting a Moonstone Chest guarantees your items are safe from other players on multiplayer survival servers.
Crafting a bed requires 3 wool and 3 wooden planks. Sleeping in it sets your respawn point, which is crucial before exploring dangerous caves.
Prioritize a chestplate first when crafting armor, as it provides the highest defense per material used. Gold armor breaks very quickly.
Water hydrates farmland up to 4 blocks away horizontally. You can build a 9x9 farm with a single water block in the exact center.
In survival PvP, critical hits are achieved by jumping and striking the opponent on your way down. This deals extra damage.
Obsidian requires a diamond pickaxe to mine. It takes several seconds per block, so make sure the area is secure before mining.
A basic bed defense starts with a layer of wool, followed by wood, and then blast-proof blocks like endstone if available. Always layer!
Speed bridging (sneaking at the edge and placing blocks quickly) is essential for rushing the first neighboring base before they gather resources.
In Bedwars, prioritize the Sharpness upgrade first if your team is aggressive, or Protection if you are focusing on defending the bed.
Controlling the middle island yields emeralds. Use these to buy diamond armor or ender pearls for clutch plays and safe escapes.
TNT is perfect for blowing through wood and wool defenses. Place it slightly above the bed to maximize the blast radius downward.
Fireballs can be used offensively to break bridges or defensively to fireball-jump across gaps when you have no blocks left.
Before drinking an invisibility potion, remove your armor. Your nameplate vanishes, but floating armor will immediately give away your position.
Buy a tracker compass when beds are destroyed. It points to the nearest living enemy, preventing endless games of hide-and-seek.
Bows are excellent for holding the middle. A Punch bow can knock players off bridges easily, securing instant kills regardless of armor.
Assign roles: One player defends the bed and collects iron, one bridges to diamonds, and two rush the adjacent base. Coordination wins games.
To earn money quickly in Greenville, take up the Mining or Woodcutting jobs. Leveling up these skills increases your cash yield per action.
Claim a plot early. You can type /plot claim to get started. Make sure you have enough money to pay the daily upkeep costs.
Vehicles are expensive but save massive amounts of travel time. Be careful not to park them in restricted zones or they may despawn.
Player-owned shops are a great way to make passive income. Sell raw materials to builders who are too lazy to mine for themselves.
Greenville is heavily social. Using the chat properly and participating in town events or mayoral elections makes the game much more enjoyable.
Double-tap the jump key to toggle flight. Use the scroll wheel to quickly change your flight speed for detailing vs outlining massive structures.
If you have owner permissions, use fill commands to clear large areas or create massive walls instantly instead of placing blocks by hand.
When building, stick to a strict 3-5 color palette. Using too many block types makes a build look chaotic and visually noisy.
Hide light sources under slabs, leaves, or behind stairs. This keeps your build illuminated without exposing ugly torches everywhere.
Never build flat walls. Add pillars, window sills, and overhangs to create depth and shadow, which drastically improves architectural design.
Use the /party command to group up with friends. This ensures you are placed on the same team in minigames like Bedwars or Murder Mystery.
If someone is breaking terms of service, use the built-in report feature. The moderation team reviews chat logs associated with the report.
You can use custom texture packs in Bloxd.io by pasting an image URL into the graphics settings. This completely changes the game's aesthetic.
Joining the official Bloxd.io Discord is the best way to find updates, submit bug reports, and advertise your custom worlds to a large audience.
When posting on BloxdHub, always include a high-quality screenshot of your build or server. Visuals get 3x more clicks than text-only posts.
The Bloxd.io Code API allows world owners to run JavaScript via Code Blocks. It exposes the global `api` object. The best place to learn is the GitHub repo.

To trigger code on events (like when a player joins or places a block), use callback functions. For example: `onPlayerJoin = (playerId) => { api.sendMessage(playerId, 'Welcome!') }`. Check the full callbacks list.

You can manipulate player stats using the API. To set a player's health, use `api.setHealth(playerId, 100)`. To check their current health before modifying it, use `api.getHealth(playerId)`. This is highly useful for custom RPG games.

Need to manipulate the world via code? While direct block placement can be tricky, the API supports moving players and editing properties. Ensure you check `api.getPlayerIds()` to loop through all active entities.

To send a server-wide announcement through your scripts, use `api.broadcastMessage('Arena starting!', { color: 'red' })`. This prints the colored text to every player's chat box, perfect for minigame timers.
